assessment.diversity_evidence: All twelve stories share the same library problem: Jun’s whale book is missing, and Ms Alvarez retrieves it from a high shelf with a ladder. The only material branch is whether Mina keeps her moon-sketch plan (s000014, s000023, s000017, s000021, s000034) or returns the atlas and draws a whale after helping Jun (s000028, s000058, s000036, s000053, s000048, s000002, s000057). Most differences are small wording or action-order changes, so this sample shows little plot or language variety; it does not establish diversity across the whole generator.

plot_groups.summary: Mina wants to sketch the moon and promises to help Jun find his missing whale book; Ms Alvarez retrieves the book, while Mina keeps her atlas and draws the moon.
Mina puts aside her moon-sketch plan to help Jun recover his missing whale book, then uses his book to draw a whale.
